Name: Ladder and Volcano Outline
Author: ogahalo00
Description:
[b]Ladder and Volcano Outline[/b] is a quality-of-life mod inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22052]Ladder Light[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3094]Ladder Locator[/url]. In addition to drawing high-visibility outlines around ladders and shafts, it features smart directional pointers (arrows) that point directly to all revealed ladders, shafts, and [b]Ginger Island Volcano Dungeon exits & switches[/b]—even when they are far off-screen!

Never wander blindly in the dark, lose track of ladders after a bomb explosion, or struggle to find hidden floor buttons in the Volcano Dungeon again!

[line]

[size=5][b]🌟 Features[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]🎯 Directional Pointers (Arrows)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Smart arrow indicators[/b]: Points towards active ladders, shafts, volcano exits, and floor buttons.[/*]
[*][b]Screen Edge Mode[/b]: Pointers stick to screen borders when targets are off-screen, complete with distance display (e.g. 15m) and label.[/*]
[*][b]On-Screen Markers[/b]: Floating, bouncing arrows appear directly above targets when they enter your viewport.[/*]
[*][b]Player Orbit Mode[/b]: Optional arrows circling your farmer pointing towards each target.[/*]
[*][b]Multi-target Support[/b]: Displays multiple pointers simultaneously with automatic overlap separation.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]🌋 Full Volcano Dungeon Support (Ginger Island)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Next Floor Exit / Stairs[/b]: Points straight to the stairs/cave doorway leading to the next level (Floors 0 to 9, leading to Caldera/Forge).[/*]
[*][b]Floor Buttons / Switches[/b]: Highlights floor buttons needed to open dwarf gates, showing live progress counts (e.g. [i]Gate Switch (0/2)[/i] ➔ [i]Gate Switch (1/2)[/i]).[/*]
[*][b]Locked Dwarf Gates[/b]: Highlights locked gates blocking your progression with distinct outlines and arrows.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Auto-Hide[/b]: Once you step on a button or the gate opens, its indicator immediately vanishes to keep your screen clean and clutter-free![/*]
[/list][size=4][b]🕳️ Full Support for Shafts (Holes)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Separate detection and distinct customizable colors for ladders (green) and shafts (cyan) in Skull Cavern.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]🎨 Fully Customizable Outlines[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Highlights ladder, shaft, gate, and switch tiles with customizable colors, opacity, and thickness.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]🌐 Full Translation Support (i18n)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]English ([i]default.json[/i]) and Vietnamese ([i]vi.json[/i]) included out of the box. Community translations are warmly welcomed![/*]
[/list][size=4][b]⚙️ In-Game Configuration[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Fully integrated with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] with organized sections for Mines and Volcano Dungeon.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]🛠️ Installation Guide[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] installed.[/*]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (3.18.6+ / 4.0+).[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the [b]LadderOutline[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]([i]Optional but recommended[/i]) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy in-game settings.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]⚙️ Configuration (config.json)[/b][/size]

You can configure everything in-game via [b]GMCM[/b] or by editing [b]config.json[/b]:

[code]
{
"EnableMod": true,
"ToggleKey": "None",
"DebugMode": false,
"EnableOutline": true,
"OutlineColor": "Green",
"ShaftOutlineColor": "Cyan",
"OutlineOpacity": 0.6,
"OutlineThickness": 3,
"EnablePointer": true,
"PointerStyle": "ScreenEdge",
"ShowOffscreenOnly": true,
"ShowOnscreenMarker": true,
"ShowDistance": true,
"ShowTargetType": true,
"LadderPointerColor": "Green",
"ShaftPointerColor": "Cyan",
"PointerScale": 4.0,
"PulseAnimation": true,
"EnableVolcano": true,
"ShowVolcanoExit": true,
"ShowVolcanoSwitches": true,
"ShowVolcanoGates": true,
"HideOpenedSwitchesAndGates": true,
"VolcanoExitColor": "Green",
"VolcanoSwitchColor": "Yellow",
"VolcanoGateColor": "Red"
}[/code][size=4][b]Options Breakdown:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]EnableMod[/b]: Master switch to turn the mod on or off.[/*]
[*][b]ToggleKey[/b]: Hotkey to toggle the mod during gameplay (e.g. "F6" or "None").[/*]
[*][b]PointerStyle[/b]: "ScreenEdge" (screen borders), "PlayerOrbit" (around farmer), or "Both".[/*]
[*][b]ShowOffscreenOnly[/b]: If true, screen-edge arrows only appear when the target is outside your screen.[/*]
[*][b]ShowOnscreenMarker[/b]: Shows a floating bouncing arrow above targets when visible in your viewport.[/*]
[*][b]ShowDistance[/b]: Displays distance in meters/tiles next to the arrow.[/*]
[*][b]ShowTargetType[/b]: Displays label (Ladder, Hole, Next Floor, Gate Switch, Locked Gate) next to the arrow.[/*]
[*][b]PulseAnimation[/b]: Smooth bobbing/breathing effect for arrows.[/*]
[*][b]EnableVolcano[/b]: Master toggle for Volcano Dungeon features on Ginger Island.[/*]
[*][b]ShowVolcanoExit[/b]: Show arrow and outline for the next floor's stairs/cave.[/*]
[*][b]ShowVolcanoSwitches[/b]: Show arrows and outlines for floor buttons that open gates.[/*]
[*][b]ShowVolcanoGates[/b]: Show arrow and outline for locked dwarf gates.[/*]
[*][b]HideOpenedSwitchesAndGates[/b]: Automatically hides buttons after they are pressed and gates after they are opened.[/*]
[*][b]Colors[/b]: Available colors: Green, Cyan, Yellow, Red, Blue, Purple, Orange, White, Pink.[/*]
[/list][line]
